title: Step-by-Step Guide to Word Reports in Business Central
summary: Word reports in Business Central allow developers to create report objects while power users design the layout in Microsoft Word, enabling document-style reports like invoices or activity summaries. This approach separates data definition from presentation design using Word's XML mapping features.
key_points: Word reports use DefaultLayout = Word and WordLayout property to reference a DOCX file for formatting
Developers create the report object with dataset and columns; Word users export and edit the layout through Report Layouts page
XML Mapping in Word's Developer pane connects report data elements to the document structure
Repeating controls in Word tables display multiple rows from nested dataitems
Custom layouts can be created, edited, and marked as default to override the report's built-in layout
